headline: South Africa Seeks Relief From Proposed EU Hybrid-Vehicle Import Restrictions
summary: South Africa is seeking relief from proposed European Union hybrid-vehicle curbs that threaten roughly 36 billion rand in automotive sector exports.
why: The automotive industry represents a major manufacturing and export pillar for South Africa's economy and trade balance with Europe.

impacts.name: Automotive Sector
impacts.why: EU import restrictions pose a direct revenue risk to South African vehicle manufacturers and exporters.
